packets.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
packets.department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
packets.benefits: One-year renewable life cover of INR 200000 for death from any cause, subject to policy terms. Standard annual renewal premium INR 436; first-time mid-year entry has pro-rata options. A 30-day non-accidental-death lien applies on first entry.
packets.audience: Individual account holders of participating banks/post offices; entry age 18 to 50. Continued cover to age 55 is subject to renewal and policy conditions. No personal eligibility conclusion.
packets.application: Request enrolment with a participating bank/post office using its prescribed form and consent to premium auto-debit. Confirm applicable first-entry premium and terms.
documents: Prescribed enrolment and auto-debit consent/declaration form
gaps: Full insurance policy/claims exclusions and all amendments need editorial review
Official FAQ lists last updated 2026-01-05; retrieval alone is not certification of later policy changes

packets.department: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance
